observation_summary: The method createCopy throws an IllegalArgumentException when the calculated end index is less than the start index, even if the range is simply empty. The fix adds a condition to handle this case gracefully by setting emptyRange to true instead of throwing an exception.
reasoning_summary: The bug is caused by an insufficient validation check. The code was checking if the range was empty based only on the end index, but it failed to account for cases where the end index is valid but smaller than the start index. The fix adds a missing condition to the existing if-statement to correctly identify an empty range, which is a classic 'Checking' defect.
evidence_used: The stack trace shows an IllegalArgumentException: 'Requires start <= end.'
The fix modifies an if-statement condition: 'if (endIndex < 0) {' becomes 'if ((endIndex < 0) || (endIndex < startIndex)) {'
The bug report states: 'Here I would expect an empty serie to be returned, not an exception.'

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While the logic for determining the range was slightly flawed, the fix is specifically the addition of a validation check to an existing conditional branch, which fits the definition of 'Checking' better than 'Algorithm/Method'.
